---
title: "Developer Year in Review"
output:
  html_document:
    includes:
      in_header: header/header.html
      after_body: include_footer.html
lang: "en"
---

Commit totals and streaks reflect my personal commits in public repositories. Automated bot commits are excluded. Streaks use UTC calendar days.

<style>
.year-hero { margin: 2rem 0; padding: 2.4rem; border-radius: 18px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#111827,#1f2937); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
.year-kicker { text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.16em; font-size:.8rem; opacity:.72; }
.year-title { font-size:clamp(2.3rem,7vw,5.6rem); line-height:.95; margin:.4rem 0 1.6rem; font-weight:800; }
.year-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(145px,1fr)); gap:1rem; }
.year-stat { padding:1rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
.year-stat strong { display:block; font-size:1.8rem; }
.year-stat span { opacity:.72; font-size:.9rem; }
.year-details { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr)); gap:.8rem; margin-top:1.2rem; }
.year-detail { padding:.9rem 1rem; border-radius:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
.year-project { margin-top:1.2rem; padding:1rem 1.1rem; border-left:4px solid #60a5fa; background:rgba(96,165,250,.12); border-radius:0 10px 10px 0; }
.year-note { opacity:.62; font-size:.8rem; margin-top:1.1rem; }
.year-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.6rem; margin:1.5rem 0; }
.year-nav a { padding:.6rem 1rem; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:999px; text-decoration:none; font-weight:600; }
.year-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background:#111827; color:#fff; border-color:#111827; }
.year-hero[hidden] { display:none; }
.year-hero table { width:100%; margin-top:1rem; color:#fff; }
.year-hero th, .year-hero td { padding:.5rem; text-align:left; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); }
.year-hero td:first-child { overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.year-hero caption { color:#fff; text-align:left; font-weight:600; }
@media(max-width:480px) { .year-hero { padding:1.2rem; } .year-stat strong { font-size:1.5rem; } }
</style>

```{r year-review, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
files <- list.files("data/year-in-review", pattern = "^[0-9]{4}\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
if (!length(files) || !requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat('<div class="year-hero"><div class="year-kicker">Developer archive</div><div class="year-title">YEAR IN CODE</div><p>The first snapshot will appear here after the annual GitHub Action runs.</p></div>')
} else {
  years <- as.integer(sub("\\.json$", "", basename(files)))
  files <- files[order(years, decreasing = TRUE)]
  reviews <- lapply(files, jsonlite::fromJSON)
  cat('<p>Explore a year of commits, projects, and coding activity. Choose a year below.</p>')
  cat('<nav class="year-nav" aria-label="Review year">')
  for (d in reviews) {
    cat(paste0('<a href="#year-', d$year, '">', d$year,
               if (isTRUE(d$is_partial_year)) ' · YTD' else '', '</a>'))
  }
  cat('</nav>')
  val <- function(x, fallback="—") if (is.null(x) || is.na(x) || identical(x, "")) fallback else x
  escape <- function(x) as.character(htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(val(x))))
  fmt <- function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) format(x, big.mark=",", scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE) else val(x)
  for (d in reviews) {
  cat(paste0(
    '<section class="year-hero" id="year-', d$year, '" aria-label="', d$year, ' developer review">',
    '<div class="year-kicker">', if (isTRUE(d$is_partial_year)) 'Year to date' else 'Developer year in review', '</div>',
    '<div class="year-title">', d$year, ' IN CODE</div>',
    '<div class="year-grid">',
      '<div class="year-stat"><strong>', fmt(d$commits), '</strong><span>commits</span></div>',
      '<div class="year-stat"><strong>', fmt(d$pull_requests), '</strong><span>pull requests</span></div>',
      '<div class="year-stat"><strong>', fmt(d$repositories_touched), '</strong><span>repositories touched</span></div>',
      '<div class="year-stat"><strong>', fmt(d$lines_added), '</strong><span>lines added</span></div>',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="year-details">',
      '<div class="year-detail"><strong>Top language by lines added:</strong> ', escape(d$most_used_language), '</div>',
      '<div class="year-detail"><strong>Most-active month:</strong> ', escape(d$most_active_month), '</div>',
      '<div class="year-detail"><strong>Longest streak:</strong> ', fmt(d$longest_streak_days), ' days</div>',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="year-project"><strong>Biggest project</strong><br>', escape(d$biggest_project),
      if (!is.null(d$biggest_project_commits)) paste0(' · ', fmt(d$biggest_project_commits), ' commits') else '', '</div>',
    if (!is.null(d$repository_commits)) paste0(
      '<table><caption>Projects this year</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Repository</th><th scope="col">Commits</th></tr></thead><tbody>',
      paste(vapply(names(d$repository_commits), function(repo) paste0(
        '<tr><td>', escape(repo), '</td><td>', fmt(d$repository_commits[[repo]]), '</td></tr>'
      ), character(1)), collapse=''), '</tbody></table>') else '',
    '<div class="year-note">', escape(d$scope), ' Snapshot generated ', substr(val(d$generated_at),1,10), '.</div>',
    '</section>'
  ))
  }
}
```

Past reviews are reconstructed from public commit history. Each January 1, GitHub Actions saves the year that just ended. The current year is a snapshot through its generation date.

<script>
(function () {
  const reviews = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('section.year-hero[id]'));
  const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.year-nav a'));
  if (!reviews.length) return;
  function selectYear() {
    const selected = reviews.find(review => '#' + review.id === window.location.hash) || reviews[0];
    reviews.forEach(review => { review.hidden = review !== selected; });
    links.forEach(link => {
      if (link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + selected.id) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
  }
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', selectYear);
  selectYear();
})();
</script>
